brief: A planter of four cells with a water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell.

requirements.evidence: Four full bases in a row (piece:0,0,0;full through piece:3,0,0;full), each holding a drained third-depth bin (bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-third-drain … bin:3,0,0~hex-bin-third-drain), all filled with soil and planted (prop:1–prop:4).

requirements.requirement: Water pipe running through the bases
requirements.evidence: Single irrigation run run:run-1 starts at cell 0,0 and passes straight through cells 1,0, 2,0 and 3,0 at level 0, so it runs through every base.

The irrigation run passes through all four bases and each cell has a drained bin with soil and a plant, so the pipe reaches every cell. The configurator checks fit only and cannot verify actual water delivery, flow or waterproofing of the printed parts.

finish.summary: Built a four-cell planter in a straight row: four full hex bases, one irrigation pipe run threaded through all four bases at level 0, and a drained third-depth planter bin in each cell (third depth is what fits alongside a through pipe). All bins are filled with soil and planted, open faces are capped, joints are bolted, and check_build passes with meshClash clear.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: 1 run IRRIGATION: non-potable supply. Corners are flexible hose, glued into Sch 40 sockets, one coupling wherever hose meets rigid pipe.

Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes

events.text: Four-cell planter with through-fed watering — I'll lay out the cells, run the pipe through every base, then plant them.
